mapper.select: SELECT c.category_name as categoryName, ABS(SUM(vt.amount)) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as transactionCount FROM v_all_transactions vt JOIN category c ON vt.category_id = c.category_id WHERE vt.member_id = #{memberId} AND YEAR(vt.transacted_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(vt.transacted_at) = #{month} AND vt.inout_type = 'O' AND vt.category_id IS NOT NULL AND vt.category_id != 10 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (a.week_num) WEEK), '%Y-%m-%d') as weekStart, CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (a.week_num) WEEK)), '년 ', WEEK(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (a.week_num) WEEK), 1), '주') as weekLabel, COALESCE(ABS(SUM(vt.amount)), 0) as totalAmount FROM ( SELECT 0 as week_num UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 ) a LEFT JOIN v_all_transactions vt ON vt.member_id = #{memberId} AND vt.inout_type = 'O' AND vt.transacted_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (a.week_num + 1) WEEK) AND vt.transacted_at < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL a.week_num WEEK) GROUP BY a.week_num, weekStart, weekLabel ORDER BY a.week_num DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL a.month_num MONTH), '%Y-%m') as monthKey, CONCAT(YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL a.month_num MONTH)), '년 ', MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL a.month_num MONTH)), '월') as monthLabel, COALESCE(ABS(SUM(vt.amount)), 0) as totalAmount FROM ( SELECT 0 as month_num UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 ) a LEFT JOIN v_all_transactions vt ON vt.member_id = #{memberId} AND vt.inout_type = 'O' AND YEAR(vt.transacted_at) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL a.month_num MONTH)) AND MONTH(vt.transacted_at) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL a.month_num MONTH)) GROUP BY a.month_num, monthKey, monthLabel ORDER BY a.month_num DESC

SELECT c.category_name as categoryName, COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(vt.transacted_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(vt.transacted_at) = #{month} THEN vt.amount END)), 0) as currentAmount, COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(vt.transacted_at) = IF(#{month} = 1, #{year} - 1, #{year}) AND MONTH(vt.transacted_at) = IF(#{month} = 1, 12, #{month} - 1) THEN vt.amount END)), 0) as previousAmount FROM category c LEFT JOIN v_all_transactions vt ON c.category_id = vt.category_id AND vt.member_id = #{memberId} AND vt.inout_type = 'O' WHERE c.category_id BETWEEN 1 AND 9 GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_id

SELECT COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(transacted_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(transacted_at) = #{month} THEN amount END)), 0) as totalAmount, COALESCE(ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(transacted_at) = IF(#{month} = 1, #{year} - 1, #{year}) AND MONTH(transacted_at) = IF(#{month} = 1, 12, #{month} - 1) THEN amount END)), 0) as previousAmount FROM v_all_transactions WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND inout_type = 'O'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(transacted_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(transacted_at) = #{month} THEN amount END), 0) as totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(transacted_at) = IF(#{month} = 1, #{year} - 1, #{year}) AND MONTH(transacted_at) = IF(#{month} = 1, 12, #{month} - 1) THEN amount END), 0) as previousAmount FROM v_all_transactions WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND inout_type = 'I'
